facts.fact: Voice state separately has current transcript, transcriptOriginal, correction suggestions, transcriptConfirmed/ConfirmedAt and feedback. Fixture and ASR completion populate original/current text; correction application changes current text and refresh marks confirmation false. No answer-revision field appears in these inspected state/edit functions.
facts.boundary: Static current object semantics; not a persistence or reliable version-identity guarantee.

facts.fact: Textarea changes enter voice state when interviewVoiceReadTranscript runs; the general input handler does not capture this textarea. The analyze action reads it, marks confirmed and invokes analysis; analysis reads again and stamps current confirmation time.
facts.boundary: Text exists in the DOM before capture. Unrelated render replaces app HTML, so loss of unconfirmed edits is a static path risk; no browser reproduction done.

facts.fact: No-adapter local rules receive current text at analysis and return the trimmed text inside feedback.transcript.text plus derived summary/evidence and provenance. Adapter invocation is given a primitive transcript value, question ID/version/context and rubric from that call.
facts.boundary: Input-to-feedback association is explicit for local rules; adapter request parameters do not themselves validate what returned feedback belongs to. Optional runtime adapter installation was not evaluated.

facts.fact: Edit-from-feedback copies feedback.transcript.text when truthy, otherwise retains current transcript, and sets transcript_ready without clearing the stored feedback object. Transcript is editable only in transcript_ready/transcription_unavailable. Page renders feedback only when status is feedback; editing and analyzing hide the old feedback.
facts.boundary: Old object retained in memory is distinct from old feedback visible as current. No user-observed version label/behaviour certified.

facts.fact: Feedback renderer shows summary, evidence, question source, measurements and ASR/analysis/model fields; it does not render the full feedback transcript or transcriptConfirmedAt as an explicit answer revision. facts.boundary: Same current state and an echoed input snapshot are not a separately checked response-to-answer revision binding. UI comprehension remains untested.

facts.fact: Analysis runs only from transcript_ready/transcription_unavailable. Pending UI has readonly transcript/no reanalysis control but retains return navigation. Reset increments requestId and clears current transcript/feedback; recording callbacks check requestId, analysis promise handlers do not check it, source revision or active question before mutating shared voice state.
facts.boundary: Late analysis after leave/reset/new question can mutate shared state by this static path. A same-page duplicate analyze while pending is guarded; no fabricated ordinary concurrent-click scenario or actual timing defect claimed.

facts.fact: Adapter sync throw falls back to local rules, marks partial and adds analysis-unavailable uncertainty. Async result marked unavailable/error sets transcription_unavailable and preserves text for retry; async reject falls back to local partial rules. A value with answerAnalysis is accepted without checking returned transcript/question against the sent input.
facts.boundary: Failure, partial fallback and unavailable are distinct branches. Async fallback/response provenance reads mutable current state; exact visible user outcomes require runtime tests.

facts.boundary: No claim of durable answer revision history, restored feedback or effective recovery. Residual auxiliary state is not a valid saved answer version.
